name: testimonials-grid
description: Grid of testimonial quote cards with author name, role/company, and optional avatar. Replaces three v1 testimonials variants (wall/carousel/chat) with one composable block.

ai.whenToUse: Use to surface 3–6 real customer quotes. Best placed between features and pricing or just above the final CTA. Avatar fallback is auto-generated initials, so missing photos look intentional, not broken.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't fake testimonials — quotes should be from real people who consented. If you don't have any yet, replace with a `cta-strip` or omit the block entirely.

headline.example: Built for people who actually ship

subheadline.example: Quotes pulled from interviews with teams currently in production.

items.description: Testimonials. Each has a quote, author name, optional role/company/avatar/rating.

example.quote: Switched from Next on Vercel — preview deploys are actually atomic now.
